summary: BUDGY v3.8.0 (pre-build 70) — E2E Famille & Groupes Cloud. Precheck DB objects PASS (group_invites table, join_group_by_code RPC, leave_group RPC, expense_groups.member_user_ids column all present). Full E2E flow executed at Supabase API level across 3 accounts (User A/B/C) mirroring familyCloud.ts client logic. 18/19 assertions PASS. Only issue: after group DELETE, orphan rows remain in group_invites (missing ON DELETE CASCADE FK). UI smoke test confirmed /more/family renders with testID='family-screen', 'Créer un groupe' & 'Rejoindre avec un code' CTAs visible, no RN red screen, no runtime errors.

S4_RLS_userA_sees_B_expense.note: User A GET /group_expenses returns B's row → RLS auth.uid()=ANY(member_user_ids) works cross-account. NO 42501/42P01/42703/23503/PGRST204/PGRST301 errors.

S7_userB_leaves.note: RPC leave_group 200 {ok:true}; subsequent SELECT confirms group hidden from B (RLS filter removed uid from member_user_ids)

S8_owner_cannot_leave.note: RPC leave_group as A → 400 P0001 message='owner_cannot_leave' → UI shows localised alert (family.tsx:244-249)

S10_invalid_and_short_codes.note: 'ZZZZZZZZ' → invite_not_found (localised UI). Short code 'ABC' guarded client-side in familyCloud.ts:84 (length!==8 → 'invalid_code' → UI alert 'Code invalide').

S11_persistence_after_reload.note: AUDIT-PERSIST created, re-read via API confirms persistence (Supabase-backed)

S12_cleanup.note: All AUDIT-* expense_groups deleted OK. BUT orphan row remained in group_invites (code NDJDXZFU) after parent group DELETE. Manually purged via extra DELETE. Root cause: FK group_invites.group_id likely missing ON DELETE CASCADE in SUPABASE_FAMILY.sql.

minor.issue: Deleting an expense_group does NOT cascade-delete its rows in group_invites. Leaves orphan invite codes referencing non-existent groups. Fix: alter FK constraint in docs/SUPABASE_FAMILY.sql: `FOREIGN KEY (group_id) REFERENCES expense_groups(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`. Alternatively add a trigger. Not a blocker for user flow (client resolves invite → RPC returns invite_not_found because the group row is gone), but pollutes the invites table over time.

react_native_issues.issue: Repeated console warnings 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' — non-blocking but should migrate legacy shadow styles to boxShadow for RN 0.76+/web parity. Not specific to family.tsx.
'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing' warnings on web — expected on web preview only, harmless on native builds.

action_items: Add `ON DELETE CASCADE` to the group_invites.group_id FK in /app/docs/SUPABASE_FAMILY.sql and re-apply the migration on Supabase prod (safe: drop constraint + re-add with cascade, or use `ALTER TABLE group_invites DROP CONSTRAINT ... , ADD CONSTRAINT ... REFERENCES expense_groups(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`).
Optional QoL: purge existing orphan invites once with `DELETE FROM group_invites WHERE group_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM expense_groups);` — testing agent already cleaned run-specific orphans.
Nothing else blocking — Milestone A cloud family flow is functionally complete and cross-account RLS works end-to-end.

rca_of_issue: S12 orphan invites: When `DELETE FROM expense_groups WHERE id=gid` is issued, the FK on group_invites.group_id was created without CASCADE, so PostgreSQL either refuses the delete or (in the current schema apparently) uses ON DELETE NO ACTION with a deferrable constraint, or the FK simply does not exist so the row is left dangling. Either way: rows survive parent delete. Reproduction: run e2e_family_cloud.py — final assertion 'S12.no_orphan_invites' fails deterministically. Mitigation: alter FK to CASCADE (see action_items).
verdict: PROCEED_TO_i18n — 11/11 functional scenarios PASS. Sole caveat: minor SQL schema tweak (ON DELETE CASCADE on group_invites.group_id) recommended but non-blocking for the Milestone A rollout.
